title: The UART gatekeeper
hints: A gatekeeper serialises access by design. Only one task ever touches the resource, and everyone else sends it messages. No mutex is needed, because nothing is shared.

In `log_send`, build `log_msg_t msg = {.source = source};` and copy the text with `snprintf(msg.text, sizeof msg.text, "%s", text)`. Then call `xQueueSend(g_log_q, &msg, LOG_SEND_TIMEOUT)`. The queue copies the whole struct. Set `LOG_QUEUE_LEN` to 8.

The gatekeeper loop is: `log_msg_t msg; xQueueReceive(g_log_q, &msg, portMAX_DELAY); char line[LOG_TEXT_LEN + 4]; snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%c: %s", source_letter(msg.source), msg.text); uart_write_line(line);`. In log_send, write `if (xQueueSend(...) != pdPASS) { g_log_dropped++; return pdFAIL; }`.
